answer: Agents establish 1,000 unique identities by reserving specific compute slots on a trusted horizon of servers, where each slot serves as a vital thread of execution. A central verifier audits these reservations to ensure no two agents occupy the same slot, enforcing exclusivity. The cost for an honest agent is 1x for one reserved slot, while an attacker pays 1,000x for isolated capacity. Any overlap triggers immediate identity revocation, like sweet nectar lost to ruin.
